title: Constructed ordinary tensor restriction square and its localized transport
statement: Let k:X′→X be a scheme morphism, U⊂X open, j=U.ι and p,q the projections of T=X′×X U [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-base-change]. Define openTensorRestrictionIso for an open immersion as the comparison of the chosen tensor-pullback adjunction with the usual pullback adjunction followed by restrictFunctorIsoPullback. Compose its inverse for p, inverse tensor-composition for (p,k), tensor-composition for (q,j) using the pullback condition, and its forward comparison for j to obtain tensorPullback(k);restrict(p) ≅ restrict(j);tensorPullback(q) [def-pc-tensor-pullback-composition-iso]. Its termwise action on P is openTensorRestrictionComplexIso. For Pg=tensorPullback(k)(P), define openRestrictedTensorDerivedIso:Lp*DQ(Pg)≅DQ(tensorPullback(q)(restrict(j)(P))) by openRestrictionRepresentativeIso(p,Pg) inverse [def-pc-open-derived-stalk-iso], then localization of the constructed chain isomorphism. These are actual compositions of specified isomorphisms, with no arbitrary witness chosen.

def openRestrictedTensorDerivedIso
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X X' : Scheme.{u}} (k : X' ⟶ X) (U : X.Opens)
    (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ) :
    (derivedPullback (pullback.fst k U.ι)).obj
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
          (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback k).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)) ≅
      DerivedCategory.Q.obj
        (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd k U.ι)).mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj
          (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P))
